open import Setoid.Homomorphisms

ker-in-con′ : {𝓞 𝓥 α ρᵃ β ρᵇ ℓ : Level} {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥}

              {x y : Setoid.Carrier 𝔻[ 𝑨 ]}
  →  proj₁ (kercon (πhom h θ)) x y → proj₁ θ x y
ker-in-con′ h = {!!}
